title: Diffusion: Particles on the Move
summary: Why a smell spreads through a room and ink spreads through water, and what makes it faster.

ib.note: Good vehicle for Criterion B: designing a fair test

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 7: Particulate Nature of Matter
Earlier NCERT: Matter in Our Surroundings (particles are moving; not in Exploration 2026)

objectives: I can define diffusion using the particle model.
I can explain why diffusion is fastest in gases and faster at higher temperatures.
I can design a fair test with independent, dependent and controlled variables.
misconceptions: Diffusion stops once things are evenly mixed (particles keep moving).
